subject: Hosted API quickstart & rate limits - follow up
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.example.com>
To: Alicia Chen <alicia.chen@acme.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.example.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API quickstart & rate limits - follow up

Hi Alicia —

Thanks again for taking the demo today. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps: 

What we heard from you:
- Prefer Redwood Hosted API for initial deployment (no on-prem requirement right now).
- Goal: integrate embeddings + chat assistant into Acme web app for search/summary flows.
- Success metrics: sub-300ms median token latency, sustained ~30–50 qps with 200–400 token prompts, occasional bursts up to ~100 qps.

From Redwood (high level):
- Hosted API supports those patterns; we offer streaming, batching, and prefix caching to optimize latency/cost.
- Default rate-limit profile for new accounts is configurable; we can provision a trial quota that matches your expected burst needs.

Immediate next steps:
1) I’ll provision a 14-day quickstart sandbox for Acme (API key + sample dataset).
2) Marissa (SE) will share a lightweight load/latency plan and recommended endpoints for embeddings vs generation.
3) If the quickstart looks good, we’ll map to a scoped pilot (usage commit or dedicated capacity discussion if sustained throughput grows).

Questions for you now: can you confirm the two items below so we can size the trial appropriately?
- Typical prompt length (avg tokens) you expect for chat & for embeddings ingestion (ballpark is fine).
- Any compliance requirements (SOC2, data residency) we should attach to the trial?

I attached a short quickstart doc with steps so your engineers can get going (hosted_quickstart_instructions.pdf).

Available for a 30-min follow up Thursday morning PT if your engs want to walk through keys.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.example.com
+1 (415) 555-0134

Attachments: hosted_quickstart_instructions.pdf (pdf)

From: Alicia Chen <alicia.chen@acme.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Jake Patel <jake.patel@acme.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API quickstart & rate limits - follow up

Thanks Aditya — great demo. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Deployment preference: Hosted API sounds right for the pilot. If we move to production and sustained throughput trends up, we may revisit Dedicated, but right now Hosted is best.
2) Throughput: target steady-state ~40–50 rps (combined chat+inference), with burst windows up to ~100 rps for ~5–10 minutes.
3) Prompt size: chat averages ~350 tokens (user + system + history), generation outputs ~150 tokens. Embedding documents avg ~1,200 tokens pre-chunking; we’ll chunk down to ~500 tokens per embedding.
4) Latency: we aim for P50 < 300ms end-to-end for chat.

Security/compliance: We’re SOC2 in progress; for the pilot we need basic audit logs and assurance on data retention. We might request the SOC2 checklist later — please tell us where to upload/attach.

Can you send the quickstart API key and any rate-limit guidance? Also send sample curl calls (especially for streaming).

—Alicia
Alicia Chen
Head of ML Platforms, Acme AI
alicia.chen@acme.ai

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.example.com>
To: Alicia Chen <alicia.chen@acme.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.example.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API quickstart & rate limits - follow up

Thanks Alicia — this is perfect, exactly the level of detail we need.

I’ve kicked off the quickstart sandbox for Acme and you should receive an email with temporary API keys in the next 10 minutes. Key details up front: 
- Default trial rate limit: 60 rps per-account for the first 48 hours; we can raise this for the duration of your quickstart to 120 rps if you send a short load plan (Marissa will help).
- Endpoints:
  • /v1/chat (streaming supported) — recommended for conversational flows
  • /v1/embeddings — for document embeddings (batch-friendly)
- Billing: trial is credit-backed; we’ll share estimated unit cost once we see sample traffic.

Quick links: Quickstart guide (https://redwood.example.com/quickstart?acct=acme-ai) and I added the HubSpot deal for tracking: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/5871

Marissa — can you attach a short load plan template and sample curl snippets (streaming + non-streaming) and confirm we can bump the sandbox rps to 120 for ~48hrs?

Alicia — I’ll also share our SOC2 evidence link once you confirm where to upload (or we can add you to a secure share).

Best,
Aditya

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.example.com>
To: Alicia Chen <alicia.chen@acme.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.example.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Jul 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API quickstart & rate limits - follow up

Hi Alicia / Aditya —

Following up with the SE details.

1) Load/latency plan: attached sample-load-plan.csv — fill in expected qps by endpoint and typical prompt sizes; we’ll use this to provision the sandbox burst to 120 rps for 48 hours.

2) Rate-limit policy: see rate_limit_policy.pdf for default values. For the quickstart I can temporarily raise the per-account rps to 120 and increase token concurrency. We’ll monitor and adjust.

3) Quick curl examples (short):
- Chat (streaming):
  curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>" \n    -N https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/chat \n    -d '{"model":"rwd-chat-medium","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are an assistant."},{"role":"user","content":"Summarize the following..."}]}'

- Embeddings (batch):
  curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>" \n    https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/embeddings \n    -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-large","input":["doc chunk 1","doc chunk 2"]}'

4) SOC2: Alicia — we can share our SOC2 report and evidence via a secure ShareFile link. Reply with preferred upload method and I’ll grant access.

Attachments: sample-load-plan.csv (csv), rate_limit_policy.pdf (pdf)

If you’re open, I can schedule a 30-minute tech sync tomorrow to walk through integration gotchas (streaming chunking, retry/backoff, and caching).

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.example.com
